pretreatment: UV/ozone, dipped into 10% aqueous HF solution for 5 s
evidence: n-Type Si/H20849100/H20850, with resistivity 0.5–1 /H9024cm, was selected as the substrate. All substrates were treated in UV/ozone to remove surface organic contamination, then dipped into 10% aqueous HF solution for 5 s and rinsed with deionized water right before deposition.
